tagline.zh: 一份在 AI 时代放下框架、由作者与 Agent 共创的双语独立数字刊物
tagline.en: An independent bilingual digital journal crafted directly in HTML by its author and AI agents

description.zh: 全静态、零框架、开源双语个人出版物。记录独立博客、个人审美、开源实践与 AI 时代的创造方式。
description.en: A fully static, frameworkless, open-source bilingual personal publication exploring independent blogging, craft, open source, and creation in the age of LLMs.

description.zh: 从虚拟主机、WordPress 到无框架静态网页，个人数字自留地的演进与回归。
description.en: The evolution and return of personal corners of the web — from shared hosts and WordPress to frameworkless HTML.

description.zh: 放下构建工具与模板拐杖，以一页原生 HTML5 作为自由呼吸与生长的画布。
description.en: Setting down templates and build crutches to let native HTML5 act as a living, breathing canvas.

description.zh: 当想象力与执行力之间的距离归零，大语言模型如何重塑个人的思考与表达。
description.en: How large language models collapse the distance between an idea and its finished form, reshaping personal thought and expression.

description.zh: 跳出千篇一律的社区模板与祖传 CSS，让样式从形式装饰跃进为人的精神传递。
description.en: Stepping beyond lookalike templates and heirloom CSS so visual style carries personal sensibility and spirit.

description.zh: 把每一行代码交由开源仓库与 Commit 记录留存，见证一个时代的思维与手艺。
description.en: Preserving every line of code in public commit history as a living witness to how an era thought and built.

reading_time.zh: 5 分钟 · 含 2 组交互装置

zh.title: 让博客重新成为博客
zh.kicker: 创刊特稿 · 个人出版
zh.deck: 从初中的 Hexo、宝塔面板与 Sakurairo，到今天一页白纸般的原生 HTML 画布——当样式不再只是为了好看而好看的形式，博客终于可以顺着思潮呼吸、生长、演进。
zh.summary: 从初中的 Hexo、宝塔面板与 Sakurairo，到今天一页白纸般的原生 HTML 画布——内含抽象交互装置「从框架到白纸」与自由画纸「一页白纸和一支笔」。

en.title: Let Blogs Be Blogs Again
en.deck: From middle-school Hexo builds, Baota panels, and Sakurairo themes to a blank sheet of native HTML — when style stops being mere decoration, a blog breathes, grows, and evolves with thought again.
en.summary: From middle-school Hexo builds, Baota panels, and Sakurairo themes to a blank sheet of native HTML — featuring an abstract interactive evolution piece and a blank sketching sheet.
